claim: Let \(\Phi:M_2\to M_2\) be a trace-preserving qubit channel of Kraus rank exactly \(2\), and choose a minimal Kraus pair \(A_0,A_1\). Define \[q_\Phi(z_0,z_1)=\det(z_0A_0+z_1A_1)=z^{\mathsf T}Mz,\]with \(M\) complex symmetric, and let \(s_1\ge s_2\ge0\) be the Takagi singular values of \(M\). These are independent of the chosen minimal Kraus pair. For any finite Kraus representation \(\{B_k\}\), followed by the optimal outcome-dependent unitary correction of Gregoratti--Werner, \[F_{\mathrm{corr}}(\{B_k\})=\frac12+\frac12\sum_k|\det B_k|.\]As the finite Kraus representation varies, the attainable optimal corrected fidelities are exactly \[\left[\frac{1+s_1-s_2}{2},\frac{1+s_1+s_2}{2}\right].\]Both endpoints and every intermediate value are attainable already by two-outcome unitary remixings of a Takagi Kraus pair. Thus measurement independence holds exactly when \(s_2=0\). For qubit amplitude damping with damping probability \(p\), the interval collapses to \((1+\sqrt{1-p})/2\); for the rank-two dephasing channel with Kraus operators \(\sqrt p\,I\) and \(\sqrt{1-p}\,Z\), it is \([\max(p,1-p),1]\).

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic random-channel replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact best-to-worst fidelity interval over all finite rank-one environment measurements for every Kraus-rank-two qubit channel, together with an iff measurement-independence criterion.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: Fixed-decomposition optimal feedback is credited to Gregoratti--Werner; determinant/concurrence geometry to Uhlmann; amplitude-damping measurement-choice results to Memarzadeh--Cafaro--Mancini.

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to trace-preserving single-qubit channels of minimal Kraus rank exactly two.
The conditional recovery is the optimal unitary correction for each observed Kraus branch.
The measurement class is finite rank-one environment measurements, equivalently finite Kraus refinements after finite dilation.
Higher Kraus rank, higher system dimension, coarse-grained outcomes, and nonunitary recovery maps are not classified.
An equivalent formulation may exist in determinant-concurrence or concurrence-of-assistance literature not surfaced by the searches.
title: Exact environment-measurement fidelity interval for every rank-two qubit channel
